output.headline: Dental strategics and healthcare-focused sponsors form the buyer universe for this Southeast dental practice; upper-quartile pricing at 15.4x EV/EBITDA is defensible.
sentences: Call Heartland Dental and Aspen Dental (ADMI) first, since both have closed larger deals in the target's own sub-sector; the order among the seven sponsors is close to a tie, with the winner in the top 3 only 28% of the time against 20% at random [E:tier1, E:sponsor_ordering].

Upper-quartile pricing at 15.4x EV/EBITDA is defensible because the target's 18.0% margin beats the comparable median of 12.4%; strategics can pay it comfortably, while sponsors would be stretching [E:valuation, E:tier1].

The review removed and merged no one; Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners stay in Tier 2 until their appetite for tech-enabled services is confirmed before outreach [E:review, E:tier2].
Most buyers in provider deals share one motive, geographic expansion, cited in 90% of 284 provider deals, so lead the pitch with the target's Southeast footprint [E:motives].
